subfiles.title: List of papers on petroleum in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An internal index describes correspondence and consular reports concerning petroleum regulation, refining, imports, and the developing Japanese oil monopoly in the Kwantung Leased Territory and Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: List of papers (1934-35): Kwantung's petroleum monopoly, Dairen refinery, gasoline storage, Union Oil's visit, and a reported foreign-firm boycott of Japan and Manchukuo.

subfiles.title: Memorandum on the command of Japanese forces in Taiwan
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.about: The memorandum briefly evaluates a consular report on a change in command of Japanese forces in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Memo: a new Japanese commander in Taiwan seemed sympathetic to the Army's ruling faction; judged not of particular interest.

interest: Shows US reporting on Japan's 1934-35 petroleum monopoly and Dairen refinery in Kwantung and Manchuria.
